# vivijure.com

> Vivijure: free AGPL-3.0 self-hosted AI film studio. Studio 1.0 open train.
> Dual-panel parity (Cloudflare or local), own-GPU LTX/CogVideoX doors, RunPod, cloud motion,
> cast LoRAs, finish chain, agent MCP, Slate Discord co-writer.

## Product
- Site: https://vivijure.com
- Demo: https://demo.vivijure.com
- Constellation map: https://github.com/skyphusion-labs/vivijure
- Control panel (Cloudflare): https://github.com/skyphusion-labs/vivijure-cf
- Control panel (Docker / home / cloud): https://github.com/skyphusion-labs/vivijure-local
- Shared core: https://github.com/skyphusion-labs/vivijure-core
- Agent MCP: https://github.com/skyphusion-labs/vivijure-mcp
- Optional hosted provisioner: https://github.com/skyphusion-labs/vivijure-control-plane
- GPU backend (RunPod): https://github.com/skyphusion-labs/vivijure-backend
- Own-GPU LTX 12GB: https://github.com/skyphusion-labs/vivijure-local-12gb
- Own-GPU CogVideoX 16GB: https://github.com/skyphusion-labs/vivijure-local-16gb
- Wan cast train (cloud i2v): https://github.com/skyphusion-labs/vivijure-wan-train
- MuseTalk / upscale / audio-upscale finish satellites
- Discord co-writer: https://github.com/skyphusion-labs/slate
